purpose: Remove the privileged latent coordinates that made G3.2 reducible to exact affine/GF(2) identification.
hard_condition: Neither the target operator nor a sufficient observation chart/basis is supplied at origin.
candidate_question: Can CFL infer a representation in which two partial observations become jointly identifiable and then synthesize a certified operator, outperforming matched representation-learning and symbolic-system-identification baselines?
domains: graph relational representations with hidden relabeling and motif basis
polynomial ideals under hidden nonlinear coordinate charts
Diophantine families under latent parameterizations not supplied to the solver
mechanics under hidden generalized coordinates and coupling basis
mandatory_baselines: autoencoder or nonlinear latent regression under matched budget
